title: Partner publish preflight for SMB & ISV - draft
body:
Purpose:
This is a compact, practical preflight + micro-copy slate for small-to-midsize partners (SMB and ISV) publishing Redwood Inference listings across cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, GCP) or our partner portal. The goal is to reduce back-and-forth by giving engineering, partner success, and partner marketing a single quick checklist + ready-to-paste copy snippets.

Audience and usage notes:
- Primary: Partner Success (onboarding), Partner Marketing, Marketplace PMs.
- Secondary: Solutions Eng, Legal (quick glance), Channel Ops.
- How to use: Fill the checklist, paste the exact copy into vendor portals, attach artifacts, escalate any open items via JIRA-INF tickets.

High-level acceptance criteria (must pass before submission):
- Functional: Deployable demo or sandbox linked (working endpoint or hosted trial).
- Security: Customer-facing support doc + SOC/attestation summary attached if requested.
- Billing: Pricing SKU mapping documented and gross-to-net calculation for reseller scenarios.
- Copy: Title, short description, long description, bullets, icon + 1 screenshot, legal footers, and support SLA blurb.
- Assets: Logo (512x512 PNG), screenshots (1200x675 jpg), 1x video URL (optional).

Marketplace-specific quick checklist:
- AWS Marketplace:
  - AMI/container or SaaS URL? (SaaS preferred for Redwood-hosted partner offers)
  - SKU mapping present: yes/no. Attach price sheet.
  - Required docs: Solution brief, MSA pointer, security attestation, architecture diagram.
  - Account team contact filled (sales alias).
  - Test: Purchase flow and SAML/OAuth test if applicable.
- Azure Marketplace:
  - Offer category selected (SaaS/Managed App).
  - Plan names match internal SKU naming convention.
  - Pricing model: Monthly seat / usage / consumption — specify examples.
  - Co-sell? (yes/no) If yes, attach co-sell package doc.
- GCP Marketplace:
  - SaaS offer or deployment template? Confirm.
  - Billing integration tested (billing account ID).
  - Tagging: android-style tags and public product ID set.

Assets and copy to prepare (copy snippets below):
- Short product title (max 80 chars):
  Redwood Inference: Hosted Inference for Chat & Embeddings — Fast + Predictable
- 1-line elevator (max 140 chars):
  High-throughput LLM inference with predictable latency and cost controls — deploy hosted, dedicated, or private.
- 50–150 word long description (marketing-friendly):
  Redwood Inference provides a production-grade inference platform for teams building LLM-powered features. Ship with confidence using our hosted API for rapid time-to-value, reserved Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput, or Private deployment for regulated environments. The platform includes batching and KV caching optimizations, rollout policies for safe model changes, cost-aware recommendations, and first-class observability. Ideal for product teams who need latency, reliability, and predictable unit economics without building server-side inference infrastructure.
- Top 5 bullets (benefit-focused):
  • Fast onboarding: simple REST/SDK + starter prompts and templates.
  • Cost controls: batching, caching, and quantization guidance to reduce per-token spend.
  • Reliable serving: SLA-backed Dedicated pools and multi-region fallbacks.
  • Flexible deployments: hosted API, reserved capacity, or customer-managed private cloud.
  • Observability: token-level cost and latency breakdowns and rollout tooling.
- Support & SLA blurb (short):
  Standard support includes email response within 48 hours. Enterprise plans include 24/7 incident support and dedicated success engineering. See linked SLA doc for details.
- Legal footer sample (short):
  By using this listing you agree to Redwood Inference terms of service and applicable cloud marketplace terms. Contact legal@redwood.ai for custom agreements.

Pricing/Plan naming & example mappings (starter suggestions):
- Free / Developer (trial): free tier includes 1M tokens / 30 days trial (Hosted only).
- Standard: $0.XX per 1k tokens (hosted shared capacity) — example: $0.015 / 1k tokens.
- Dedicated Small: monthly $X,000 reserved (baseline throughput up to Y RPS).
- Private: licensing + deployment fee — contact sales.
Notes: For marketplace SKU entries use machine-friendly plan ids: rwinf-dev, rwinf-standard, rwinf-ded-small, rwinf-private. Attach explicit mapping sheet when filing.

Copy snippets for listing tile variants (short to long) — ready to paste:
- Tile short: "High-performance LLM inference with cost controls"
- Tile long: "Run inference with predictable latency and cost. Redwood Inference offers hosted APIs, reserved GPU pools, and private deployments with built-in caching and model rollouts to keep production apps fast and reliable."

Screenshots & media guidance:
- Required: product UI screenshot (console route page, token breakdown view), sample response stream screenshot, architecture diagram.
- Preferred: short demo clip (30–60s) showing request->response and observability.
- Filenames: rwinf_icon_512.png, rwinf_console_route.jpg, rwinf_arch_diagram.jpg

Technical preflight for Solutions Engineering:
- API Key flow verified for trial tenant and partner sandbox.
- Token usage and billing metrics visible in console for test account.
- Model versions pinned in submission notes and fallback policies documented.
- Integration checklist: webhooks verified, function/tool call examples present, streaming endpoints validated.

Operational handoffs (who does what):
- Partner Success (owner): drive listing creation, coordinate required legal artifacts, validate trial flow.
- Partner Marketing: polish copy, collect screenshots and videos, create marketplace tile.
- Solutions Eng: validate deployment instructions, create sandbox credentials, run purchase test.
- Sales Ops: SKU mapping and pricing sign-off, marketplace billing tests.

Testing & validation steps (pre-publish):
- End-to-end purchase flow test run by Solutions Eng + Sales Ops.
- Post-publish smoke test: list link reachable, screenshots show correct tenant, trial provisioned.
- Monitoring: set up alert for failed provisioning, and a daily runbook check for first 3 days.

Unresolved / discussion items (to resolve before final):
- Do we need a separate sample contract for Dedicated plans on AWS marketplace? (legal)
- Pricing floor: confirm minimum monthly for Dedicated Small — PM to confirm with finance (open: FIN-req)
- Co-sell readiness: is our co-sell kit for Azure current? Camila to confirm updates.

Quick timeline (example, compressible):
- Day 0: gather assets + copy, get finance pricing sheet.
- Day 1–2: Solutions Eng validation + sandbox tests.
- Day 3: internal review (legal + sales ops).
- Day 4: submit to marketplace portal.
- Day 10–14: expected marketplace review + publish (varies by vendor).

Draft note and TODOs (notes to self):
- TODO Priya: attach final price mapping spreadsheet (JIRA-INF-2345).
- TODO Ethan: export console screenshot with token breakdown overlay.
- TODO Camila: produce 30s demo video snippet.
- TODO Legal: quick MSA pointer / redline accepted?

Useful links and references:
- Partner portal template: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/partner-portal-templates
- Listing examples (reference): internal marketplace product pages folder
- Internal tickets: JIRA-INF-2345 (pricing mapping), JIRA-MKT-789 (co-sell assets)

Notes on tone and localization:
- Use direct engineering-friendly tone for technical sections; customer-facing copy should be plain English and avoid jargon where possible.
- For EU listings include GDPR data residency note if partner supports regional private deployment.

Revision history:
- v0.1 (2025-10-12) initial working draft
- v0.3 (2025-11-20) added marketplace-specific preflight rows
- v0.7 (2026-01-15) pricing examples updated after FIN sync
- v0.9 (2026-02-08) cleaned copy and added unresolved item list

Open questions for the next sync:
1) Final Dedicated Small monthly floor? (Finance)
2) Should we publish a single combined listing or individual cloud-specific offers? Pro: fewer assets; Con: limits vendor-specific features. (Product + GTM decision)
3) Do we need a separate privacy/specific EU data residency blurb per listing? (Compliance)

---
Informal notes / scratchpad (feel free to cut before submitting):
- Partner onboarding is the choke point — aim to provide a single one-pager bundle we can hand to partners.
- Quick wins: pre-filled marketplace CSV for AWS + Azure (has saved 2 days on recent partners).
- If partner wants co-sell, attach pre-approved case study template (ask marketing).

End of draft.
